claim_one_line: THE FLAT AREA IS NOT ON THE CURVE, SO THE READ-OUT'S MEASURE IS FORCED (P-776's condition R6): the state's density |f|^2 is unchanged by the group, the flat density |f|^2/y^2 changes by |cz+d|^4 (78.1456 and 21.5296 for two moves), and the flat density's greatest place, found in two charts of the curve and carried back, is two different points 0.065 apart, while the invariant density's is one point, B1885's. The 0.056 shift on record was measured against an ingredient that is not defined on the curve. What R6 still holds open is the reading of the mark: one mirror pair on the line's surface, two on the one-twin surface. 0 of 19.
